snippet.title: PokAidle Trailer – Pokémon Idle with PvP, Clans & Shiny Hunting! (v1.5)
snippet.description:
Dive into PokAidle: The Everfall Chronicles – a FREE browser idle/incremental Pokémon fan game!

Features:
- Infinite dungeon & Boss Rush
- Shiny hunting with chains
- Prestige loops & Leaderboards
- PvP Arena & Clans (fresh v1.5!)
- Full Gen1 Dex (151 Pokémon)
- Rocket Casino, custom TMs, breeding

Stats after 6 days: 6k+ views, 3.8k+ plays on itch.io!

Play FREE on Itch.io
Reddit: r/incremental_games (live post!)

Daily updates driven by your feedback – thank you for the support! 🚀
